items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I knew these people because they were all interested in jazz music.

ctx.x: I knew these people because they were all interested in jazz music. I never got into any of these political issues. I escaped all that because I was so involved in music and I don't know -- I don't think I would have got into it anyway. I have never been a political man. But one might say, well, to not be political is being you know, not being a part of what's going on in the world today. But I think being involved in thearts is doing enough.
Well, Bud, I don't think -- I mean you just really have a hard job to try to think of artists who are actively politically. It doesn't go together, does it?
